name: Staged: the KALLAX wall on the right, the LISABO along the depth toward a 55" console and the clock on the back wall
notes:
Re-staged 2026-11-17 for the KALLAX wall and the dining console. Andrew: "Need a long, thin (depthwise) console for the dining room, looks too empty (same side wall where I'll place the clock)"; his two KALLAXes in the living room's inset "Looks great. Plan is to add 2 more of the latter kallaxes (should leave an inch or so of room). That deicions is made and ordered (coming Dec 1, via ikea)."; "Make sure when you pick the console it isn't too long such that it blocks the kallax that will be in the dining room." Asked where the console and the clock go: "Back wall, by the last Kallax". The room as it stood is kept as C.
Right wall: kallax-3 and kallax-4, the two Dec 1 KALLAX 3x4s lying, 115 1/4" of the 119" (derived) wall, drawn ending 1" from the back corner, 15 3/8" deep (x 112 5/8 to 128). Anchored (F-21). kallax-3 stands in the right edge of the top walkway (F-42) on his word: that warning stands.
Back wall: console-1, the rank-1 console (ONBRILL 55.1 x 11.9 x 31.5"), x 33.45 to 88.55: the free run is 58 5/8" from the kitchen walkway's edge (F-42, x 30) to 24" in front of kallax-4's last cubes (F-32, x 88 5/8), so any console up to 58" fits without blocking them; each of the five ranked fits. clock-1 centered over it, 58" to its center (F-70), with a VARPTROSS 20" either side (cords in covers behind the console) and a small FEJKA on the console.
Table: the LISABO turned along the room's depth, centered on the console and the clock (x 61): across the room its end would stop 3 7/8" from the KALLAXes. Its far end 24" from the console's drawers (F-32), so its living-room end comes within 4 3/8" of the open side: 34 3/8" with the living room's walkway (F-30). F-36: 36 1/4" on the KALLAX side; 15 5/8" to the kitchen walkway on the other, where those chairs push back, as F-36 allows for the kitchen side. All four chairs see the clock at the table's end (F-70). Pendant over the table's center.
Warnings that stand, documented: kallax-3, table-1, chair-1 and chair-2 enter the open sides' walkways (F-42), on his KALLAX placement and the table's turn.
Not placed: the Tumble 8x10 (under a table along the depth it would run 120" in a 119" room and under the console; the room is rugless now, F-66), the BESTÅ wall-hung buffet, its BLODFLÄDER canvas and the bird-of-paradise FEJKA (the console, the clock and the KALLAXes take their walls).

the second Dec 1 KALLAX, lying, ending 1" from the back corner (his "an inch or so of room"; the right wall's 119" is derived); anchored (F-21)

Bernhard 12" Blue (ordered) on the back wall, centered over the console and on the table's center line, 58" to its center (F-70, revised 2026-11-17); the screw at that height plus the hanger-to-center distance, his own screws and hooks
VARPTROSS on the back wall 20" left of the clock's center, center about 52" up; plug-in, cord in a cover down behind the console
VARPTROSS 20" right of the clock's center; as lamp-1

LISABO chair on the kitchen side, 1" off the table; it stands 5 1/2" into the kitchen walkway and pushes back into it, the kitchen side's passing F-36 allows; the warning stands
